title: Ada and the Promise
author: O. M. Halloran
blurb: Ines Hartwell, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
